turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You will not say such things, O-lan. You are my wife, my partner, and my love. I will not hear you speak of yourself as a slave.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I have prepared the sweet rice dish, Grandmother, just as you instructed. I have added the full measure of lard and sugar, and the eight fruits are arranged nicely on top.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You are right, Grandmother, the sweet rice dish is lovely. But when you are gone, who will cook for my son and his wife?

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will do my best, Grandmother, to take care of my husband and cook for him, just as you have taught me.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you worry about such things, O-lan. I will provide for our son and his wife, and make sure they have everything they need.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, don't worry, I will take care of myself and the maid will help me too. I will make sure everything is alright, just as Father says.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not trouble yourself with such thoughts, O-lan. I will care for you and see to our son's needs, just as I have always done.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have lived a good life, but it is not over yet. I must see our son married and settled before I go.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will do it, Mother, I promise. I will find a good wife and settle down, just as you want. Don't worry about me, I will be fine.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: It is not just a matter of settling down, my son. I want a good life for you and your wife, with many children and a prosperous farm.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will not fail you, Mother. I will work hard and make sure our farm prospers, so that my wife and I can have many children and live a good life.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not worry, my love, I will make sure our son is well-provided for, and our farm will prosper, just as O-lan has always wanted. I will not let you down, or our son, and I will do everything in my power to make sure your wishes are fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad you are willing to do this, my son, but I must also think of your father's future, and the farm's future. He is not as young as he once was, and I fear for his health, and for the well-being of our farm.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Do not worry about Father's health, Mother. I will take care of him and help him with the farm work, so that he does not tire himself.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am old now, and I will not be here to see you married and settled, my son. But I want you to promise me that you will not forget the lessons I have taught you, and that you will always remember to take care of your wife and your family.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I promise, Mother, to always remember your lessons and to take care of my wife and family, just as you have taken care of me and Father all these years.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad you have promised to remember my lessons, my son. But now, I must speak to your father. Wang Lung, I must know that our son will be well cared for, and that our farm will not suffer when I am gone.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not speak of leaving us. You are not going anywhere. You will rest, and recover, and we will care for you together, as a family.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know that I am old, and my body is weak. I want to see our son married and settled before I go, not burdened with the worry of caring for his family.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you speaking of leaving us, O-lan. You will recover, and we will care for you, just as you have always cared for us.
